description: make pr-preflight BASE=<sha> (as run by make batch-member-check) passes BASE to every child make through MAKEFLAGS. Tests that invoke make in fixture repositories then inherit BASE and fail with "Could not resolve BASE to a commit". Observed: 26 failures in tests/integration/worktree/test_worktree_lifecycle_metadata.py, test_worktree_release_dirty_guard.py, tests/unit/scripts/test_pr_preflight_base.py, test_worktree_create_base.py and test_worktree_create_linked.py when the changed files include Makefile. The same suite passes under plain make pr-preflight. This blocks batch-member-check for any member whose change selects these tests.
